messages:
mira: OK sharing my WFH chaos — tried to snake a 25ft ethernet through the partially open window, propped the surge strip on a stack of books, and hung a grow light over the monstera. photo: https://imgur.com/placeholder (look away if you value neat cable management)

devin: pics pls :D

mira: attached — also quick PSA: grow light + space heater tripped the breaker yesterday when I switched them both on. now light is on ‘meeting-only’ mode :grimacing:

ash: pro tip: smart plug + schedule it. saved my sanity when my succulent decided to become a toaster last winter :sweat_smile:

leo: @mira if you have coax, MoCA adapters > powerline. otherwise powerline adapters or running a long patch cable under the door are least invasive for rentals. neighbor interference is the main risk :ok_hand:

mira: landlord forbids drilling and I'm wary of powerline after flaky tests. I do have old coax but no spare modem — might try MoCA if I can scrounge an adapter.

devin: MoCA is solid. alternative: USB-C 2.5Gb NIC + tidy cable run through the door gap. also put an acoustic panel behind your monitor — meetings will thank you and cat will nap on it.

mira: cat already helped test the cable routing by stepping on the strip and nearly unplugging the router. voting time: should grow light stay on during meetings? react with :seedling: for yes, :x: for no

ash: :seedling:

leo: :seedling: but only on a canary schedule (aka night meetings only) :laughing:

devin: :x: — if it flickers during demos i'll riot

safety-bot: Friendly reminder: do not tuck power strips or adapters under rugs. risk of overheating/fire. unplug grow lights when unattended for long periods.

mira: noted — unplugging at lunch. thanks all for the tips and moral support (and for not reporting me to the landlord yet) :sweat_smile:
